verdicts.reason: A works as a left-to-right banner: the 'Sunset Sessions' headline is clearly the biggest thing and the RSVP button is strong. But the middle column is too tight, with the legal text pressed right under the URL line, and '6 pm' doesn't line up with 'Saturday'. The phone and the placeholder box are also squeezed against the right edge. B shrinks the logo into the top-left corner, where the faded circle runs over the sun icon. The headline is weaker, and the placeholder box at the bottom right overlaps the legal line and the canvas edge, so the fine print collides with it and gets cut off.
